name: nandha-leetcode-intelligence-frontend
description: Nandha LeetCode Intelligence — Weekly Contest Tracker
author: Nandha Engineering College

scripts.build:large: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 tsc && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 vite build
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const v=require('./package.json').version; fs.mkdirSync('../releases/android', {recursive: true}); const apk='android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk'; if (fs.existsSync(apk)) { fs.copyFileSync(apk, '../releases/android/Nandha_LeetCode_Intelligence_v' + v + '_latest.apk'); fs.copyFileSync(apk, '../releases/android/Nandha-LeetCode-Tracker-Latest.apk'); fs.copyFileSync(apk, '../releases/android/nandha-leetcode.apk'); fs.copyFileSync(apk, './public/Nandha-LeetCode-Tracker-Latest.apk'); fs.copyFileSync(apk, './public/nandha-leetcode.apk'); console.log('APK successfully copied to all destinations for v' + v); } else { console.error('APK not found at ' + apk); }"
scripts.build:exe: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const v=require('./package.json').version; fs.mkdirSync('../releases/windows', {recursive: true}); const files = fs.readdirSync('dist-electron'); const exes = files.filter(f => f.endsWith('.exe') && !f.includes('blockmap') && !f.includes('__uninstaller')).sort((a,b) => fs.statSync(path.join('dist-electron', b)).mtimeMs - fs.statSync(path.join('dist-electron', a)).mtimeMs); const exe = exes[0]; if (exe) { const src = path.join('dist-electron', exe); fs.copyFileSync(src, '../releases/windows/Nandha_LeetCode_Intelligence_v' + v + '_Setup.exe'); fs.copyFileSync(src, '../releases/windows/Nandha_LeetCode_Intelligence_Latest_Setup.exe'); fs.copyFileSync(src, '../releases/windows/nandha-leetcode-setup.exe'); fs.copyFileSync(src, './public/Nandha_LeetCode_Intelligence_Latest_Setup.exe'); fs.copyFileSync(src, './public/nandha-leetcode-setup.exe'); console.log('EXE successfully built and copied to all destinations for v' + v + ': ' + exe); } else { console.error('No EXE found in dist-electron'); }"
